Class Piece

java.lang.Object
src.Piece
Direct Known Subclasses:
Bishop, Brick, King, Knight, Pawn, Queen, Rook
public abstract class Piece extends Object
The overarching structure for all chess pieces. Contains the type of the piece, the color, the location on the board, and moving logic.
